task: Add the first shared public control-plane slice for Build, Operate, Proof, and a browser-local Request-to-Quote reference experience.
audience: Founders and domain experts with one valuable customer job
first_read: AgenticIncome builds governed delivery systems, operates them with explicit authority, and separates system evidence from accepted delivery and settled economics.

artifacts.notes: No fetch, storage, automatic pricing, customer send, agreement creation, credential access, or money movement.
Explicitly distinguishes current system evidence from customer or economic evidence.

checks.name: type-check
checks.evidence: TypeScript 5.9.3 completed with no errors in the Next.js 16.2.7 integration harness.

checks.name: route-regression
checks.evidence: Two node:test regressions passed, including absence of fetch and localStorage in the Request-to-Quote desk.

checks.name: production-build
checks.evidence: Next.js 16.2.7 production build compiled and statically generated /build, /build/request-to-quote, /operate, and /proof.

known_risks: The Request-to-Quote utility is deliberately local-only and is not a lead intake path.
Economic milestones define an evidence standard and do not imply that anyone has reached them.
Production promotion and domain changes remain human-gated.
